To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the lengths of the rows and columns of the Young diagram associated with the extremal characters of S_n are approximately normally distributed and that the lengths of rows and columns are asymptotically independent.

the lengths of the rows and columns of a Young diagram corresponding to an extremal character of the infinite symmetric groups with distinct Thoma parameters are asymptotically normal with a certain mean and variance.

the length of the first row in the Young diagram corresponding to an extremal character with Thoma parameter λ converges in distribution to N(λ, 1), and the length of the kth column of the same Young diagram, for any fixed k, converges to N(0, 1) in distribution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a central limit theorem of a random variable which has a discrete uniform distribution.
the asymptotic behavior of random Young diagrams corresponding extremal characters of symmetric groups.
the asymptotic behavior of random Young diagrams with a prescribed number of boxes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the growth rate of the first rows of Young diagrams corresponding to the extremal characters of S∞ is the same as that of a sequence of random variables which are independent and identically distributed.

the lengths of the rows and the columns in the Young diagrams corresponding to the extremal characters of Sn behave like the lengths of the columns in the random sampling model, and the lengths of the corresponding columns behave like the lengths the rows in the random sampling.

the first row and first column of a Young diagram of an extremal character of the infinite symmetric groups with distinct Thoma parameters grow linearly in n, and their lengths are asymptotically normal with a mean and a standard deviation given by simple formulas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the extremal characters of infinite symmetric group can be approximated by independent random sampling model.
we prove that the random Young diagrams are asymptotically Gaussian.
we have proved that the extremal characters of infinite symmetric group behave asymptotically as the characters of a random Young diagram.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the asymptotic distribution of row/column lengths in Young diagrams with extremal characters can be described by a simple model of independent random sampling.
the asymptotic behavior of extremal Young diagrams is governed by the same laws of probability as a simple independent random model.
, in the limit, the first rows and first columns of Young diagrams are asymptotically equivalent to independent random walks with a drift.
